legal_units.title: Income from house property.
legal_units.text: The annual value of property consisting of any buildings or lands appurtenant thereto, owned by the assessee shall be chargeable to income-tax under the head "Income from house property".
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 20 Income from house property. Section 20(1): The annual value of property consisting of any buildings or lands appurtenant thereto, owned by the assessee shall be chargeable to income-tax under the head "Income from house property".

legal_units.title: Income from house property.
legal_units.text: The provisions of sub-section (1) shall not apply to such portions of the property, as the assessee may occupy for his business or profession, the profits of which are chargeable to income-tax.
